amendments.normalized_body: In `tank_tui/src/main.rs:597`, the scenario selection screen displays "Filled volume" using `geometry.water_volume_l()` (gross volume without substrate displacement). Now that all chemistry uses net water volume via `state.water_volume_l()`, this display is inconsistent with the concentration math. Consider either (a) showing both gross and net volumes, or (b) labeling this as "Tank capacity" to distinguish it from actual water volume.

The `LEGACY_KINETIC_REFERENCE_VOLUME_L = 20.0` constant in process.rs derives from the default tank's net water volume (40×25×22/1000 − 40×25×2/1000 = 20 L). Add a one-line doc comment noting this derivation so a future change to default TankGeometry or default substrate depth doesn't silently break the legacy parameter bridge.
